summary: Proposes a smallest staged PCFL path: a model-free, independently runnable M0-THIN fixture and an exact public handoff for a later M-TEXT-SUPPLIED causal-use assay. It reuses only explicitly mapped, byte-identical FeltCraft V7 primitives under new authority; it does not transfer V7 authority or make M0 a scientific result.
system_thesis: Dream–LoRA–Think is a complete organism, not a single organ: lived action–outcome episodes create grounded evidence; later dream-time local connection growth and memory re-expression organize eligible experience; parametric SLEEP/LoRA consolidation transports only validated personal semantics; goal-conditioned THINK retrieves, composes, plans, acts, observes, and revises; and later thinking/outcomes may feed future dream cycles. M0 implements none of this learned organism. M-TEXT-SUPPLIED isolates only the organism-level causal usefulness of externally supplied grounded connected text; later packages separately test DREAM authorship, parametric transport, developmental learning, and the online feedback loop.
